title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Tobu Bhalobashi
desc: Raj falls in love with the pregnant wife of a man he accidentally kills on a rainy day.

title: Mangaldeep
desc: Two best friends, Mangal and Deep, embark on a journey to the big city to fulfil their musical dreams. In his quest to see Deep succeed, Mangal risks everything, including his own finances.

title: Rajar Meye Parul
desc: A childless king marries a woodcutter's daughter to gain an heir. However, his wives kill his seven children, leaving only his daughter Parul, who grows up to be a charming young lady.

title: Abhimanyu
desc: Raj Sinha, a policeman, kills gangster Durjo Rai's son in an encounter. He soon asks Abhimanyu, a suspended colleague, to protect the last two members of his family from Rai.

title: Aakrosh
desc: Two detectives investigate the disappearance of three medical students in a small village, but their search is hampered by corrupt local authorities.
